idea-plugin.name: CC Pets Terminal
idea-plugin.description: Jump from a CC Pets agent card to its JetBrains IDE terminal tab. Supports local Reworked terminals on macOS in IntelliJ-based IDEs 2026.2 and 2026.3 (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, CLion, PhpStorm, RubyMine, Rider, etc.). Connects automatically to CC Pets over authenticated localhost communication. Does not read terminal output or execute shell commands in your sessions.
